fix.pr_body:
## What was wrong

Relative date strings like "3 days ago" were displayed in deck rows, match tables, news items, and competition listings with no way to see the exact underlying timestamp without digging into the source.

## What changed

- **`shared/dtutil.py`**: Added `display_date_tooltip(dt, tz=WOTC_TZ)` which formats a datetime as `'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM TZ'` (e.g. `'2020-04-05 13:00 PDT'`).
- **`decksite/prepare.py`**: Set `display_date_title` alongside `display_date` for decks (line 104) and matches (line 159).
- **`decksite/data/news.py`**: Set `display_date_title` for news items.
- **`decksite/view.py`**: Set `display_date_title` for competitions.
- **`decksite/templates/deckrow.mustache`**: Added `title="{{display_date_title}}"` to the date `<td>`.
- **`decksite/templates/deckmatches.mustache`**: Added `title="{{display_date_title}}"` to the date `<td>`.
- **`decksite/templates/news.mustache`**: Added `title="{{display_date_title}}"` to the date `<span>`.
- **`decksite/templates/competitions.mustache`**: Added `title="{{display_date_title}}"` to the date `<td>`.

## Validation

- `uv run --frozen python dev.py lint` — passed (all checks)
- `uv run --frozen python -m pytest shared/dtutil_test.py -v` — 13 passed
- Manual verification: `display_date_tooltip` on a UTC datetime produces e.g. `'2020-04-05 13:00 PDT'` (exactly what the issue requested)

Fixes #7063
